description.value: Pho Tru is a Vietnamese restaurant in downtown Victoria rooted in the street-side food culture of Vietnam, serving pho noodle soups, vermicelli salad bowls, jasmine rice plates, Saigon subs, and fresh spring rolls made from family recipes passed through generations. The restaurant has two Victoria locations — downtown on Blanshard Street and inside Mayfair Shopping Centre — with dine-in, pick-up, and delivery available. Touring cyclists moving through central Victoria will find generous, affordable bowls well-suited to refuelling on a long ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at photru.com confirms an active, operating Vietnamese restaurant with a Downtown location at 1012 Blanshard St matching the OSM address; the contact page provides a phone number (+1 250-590-7925) not present in OSM. The homepage explicitly advertises dine-in, pick-up, and delivery, and the menu includes clearly vegetarian items (Tofu Salad Roll/Goi Cuon Chay and a Veggies jasmine rice plate). No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities was found anywhere on the website.
